methods: Q-DT fixed td denoised support top3
qdt_note: Q-DT targets use qdt.value_relabel with action-dependent modes td and q_sa. The legacy state_value target is intentionally absent from this mainline runner.
support_masks: count>=1 keeps actions observed in the same timestep/reference-bin cell
top3 keeps up to three most observed actions in that cell
top3 is applied to EVERY family (structured, vanilla, Q-DT, IQL) at inference only, so target choice and support constraint are crossed rather than confounded
